issues.evidence: Tibetan ཡིད་བདེར་མི་འགྱུར་བ (bo-shenga 6-123: ཡིད་བདེ་བར་མི་འགྱུར) means the mind is not made comfortable/happy (Skt na saumanasyam). 意樂 is the established Chinese technical term for āśaya (intention, disposition), so it risks being read as 'intention' rather than 'mental happiness'.

Tibetan གདོལ་པ་དང་ནི་མ་ཧེ་བཞིན is elliptical; bo-gyaltsab 7-5 and bo-shenga 7-5 make clear that the sleeper is compared to the buffalo that stays calm and asleep while others of its kind are slaughtered one by one by the butcher/outcaste (Skt caṇḍālamahiṣo). 'like a butcher and a buffalo' leaves the comparison unclear, as if the addressee were both.
